scenes.name: Renacimiento pop, Elephant 6 y lounge-pop
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: En la primera mitad de los noventa el pop supera ampliamente a la música experimental: la revancha de la melodía tras un cuarto de siglo de sonidos progresivos. La vía más rentable sigue el pop barroco de los últimos Beach Boys, Van Dyke Parks, Big Star y XTC: Jellyfish (Bellybutton), Imperial Teen, Velvet Crush, Material Issue, Eggs, Fountains Of Wayne, Ben Folds Five, Chainsaw Kittens, Barenaked Ladies. El colectivo «Elephant 6» de Georgia y Luisiana es la escuela pop más influyente de la década: Apples In Stereo, Olivia Tremor Control, Neutral Milk Hotel (In The Aeroplane Over The Sea), Elf Power, Of Montreal; y sus herederos Ladybug Transistor y Photon Band. El folk-pop a lo Tom Petty y R.E.M.; el «lounge-pop» (Combustible Edison, Zumpano, Ivy, Cardigans, Squirrel Nut Zippers); el teen-pop (Hanson, Britney Spears, Backstreet Boys).

podcast.body: Marcy Playground originated in Minneapolis in 1994, several years before achieving widespread fame with their breakthrough hit. "They came out of Minneapolis in 1994."

podcast.title: John Wasneyac's Life in Canada
podcast.body: John Wasneyac, the singer and leader of Marcy Playground, has resided in Canada for an extended period, is married with four sons, and is a partner in a recording studio in Vancouver, which he reportedly acquired using the financial proceeds from the hit song "Sex and Candy." "The singer and leader, John Wasneyac, has been living in Canada for quite some time."

podcast.title: Tour Routine
podcast.body: John Wozniak described a typical tour bus schedule involving playing a gig, getting on the bus to sleep, waking up in the next town due to a driver, having a little free time for personal tasks or writing music, then sound check, dinner, interviews, and finally the next gig before repeating the cycle. The only saving grace mentioned were the minutes spent performing. "It's like you play a gig. You're done with the gig. You go to the van. You go wherever, hang out in the van. I mean, the bus. I'm sorry, I'm talking about a bus here. You jump on the bus, you sleep, and you wake up in the next town because there's a driver that drives you."
